notes.title: #3 - Ballotoro is released. What's next?
notes.content: [h3][b]🚨[/b][/h3][p]So[b] Ballotoro[/b] is a short, chaotic game about rolling a ball. It's out now.[/p][p]It was built in just one month, and while I don’t expect it to sell long-term, I’m genuinely happy to see people playing it.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807080/Ballotoro"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Ballotoro taught me a lot about game development.[/p][p]It’s simple, messy, and fast — and that’s exactly what I feel "fun".[/p][p][/p][p]Before this, I was working on a much bigger project called [b]End Turn[/b].[/p][p]It had a unique idea, and I pushed "hard" trying to make something grand.[/p][p]But a year flew by, and I burned out. It stalled.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, after finishing Ballotoro, I finally feel like [i]maybe[/i] I could return to End Turn —[/p][p]But this time with a better foundation and a clearer mind[/p][p](Actually, I don't know what my brain is doing sometimes.)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Not sure yet. But I’m moving forward.[/p][p]Thanks for trying out Ballotoro — even a short game means a lot when someone chooses to play it.[/p][p]Ha, ha… One day.[/p][p]--[/p][p]flatcat[/p]

notes.title: Ver 0.3.9 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Enemiy in this game is called Foe

- Foe may come in formation of 5
- Total health is determined by number of turns passed. Distributed fairly
- Player can select which foe is targeted for effects. Select again to deselect
- Wave ends when all foes destroyed
- Adjusted playflow
- Removed kill counter
- Fixed bugs
